siegebreaker_golem.name: Siegebreaker Golem
siegebreaker_golem.design: Mini-boss: a towering siege golem of sanctum stone bound with iron bands, a battering-ram arm, glowing armour seams that close at 50% (armour phase). Tell: ram arm drawn back, seams flaring. Attack: charge slam impact.

ignaroth.name: Ignaroth, the Ember Tyrant
ignaroth.design: Ashen Horde: the Ember Tyrant, a horned magma-giant with cooling basalt crust over molten flesh, a crown of volcanic spikes, vents on the back that glow. Tell: arms raised, vents erupting light. Attack: fists into the ground.

vaelith.name: Vaelith, the Storm Tyrant
vaelith.design: Stormspire: the Storm Tyrant (she), a winged tyrant in copper-feathered armour, a crown of lightning, a storm spear. Tell: spear raised, lightning gathering. Attack: spear thrust down.

mirrath.name: Mirrath, the Mirror Queen
mirrath.design: Arcane Fractures: the Mirror Queen, a queen whose body is half mirror-shards, a fractured mirror halo, a sceptre of magenta glass. Tell: arms spread, mirrors aligning. Attack: sceptre flash.

aetherion.name: Aetherion, the Fallen Crystal
aetherion.design: Arcane Fractures: the Fallen Crystal - a dark mirror of the player's Crystal: a corrupted crystal colossus with a fractured core, floating broken facets, crystal arms. Tell: facets drawing in. Attack: arms thrown open.

thornmother.name: Thornmother
thornmother.design: Corrupted Wilds: an ancient treant matriarch with a crown of thorns and blossoms of sick green, roots for a lower body, a cradle of thorns. Tell: roots lifting. Attack: thorn arms lashing.

ironclad_warlord.name: Ironclad Warlord
ironclad_warlord.design: Iron Legion: a heavily armoured warlord in layered riveted plate with a great war banner on the back and a siege hammer. Tell: hammer raised. Attack: hammer down.

ashen_matriarch.name: Ashen Matriarch
ashen_matriarch.design: Ashen Horde: brood mother of the imps, a hunched cinder giantess with a smouldering cocoon-like abdomen and ember-eyed imps clinging to her. Tell: arms raised, abdomen glowing. Attack: claws forward.

nyxhollow.name: Nyxhollow, the Hungering Void
nyxhollow.design: Voidborn: the Hungering Void, a huge maw-creature of void flesh with star-holes, many-jointed arms and a ring of void eyes. Tell: maw opening, void light inside. Attack: lunging bite.

seraphyne.name: Seraphyne, Queen of Winter
seraphyne.design: Frozen Covenant: the Queen of Winter, tall and regal, an ice-spire crown, a gown that becomes glacier at the hem, a frost sceptre, floating snow. Tell: sceptre raised, frost gathering. Attack: sceptre pointed down.

gravemaw.name: Gravemaw, the Siege Titan
gravemaw.design: Iron Legion: the Siege Titan, a colossal armoured titan with a gaping maw-like vent in the chest and mortar barrels on the shoulders, rust and soot. Tell: shoulders braced, barrels glowing. Attack: recoil after the volley.

rift_warden.name: The Rift Warden
rift_warden.design: Final boss: the sanctum's ancient guardian statue animated and corrupted by the rift; basalt/obsidian plate, a broken halo of floating rift-crystal shards, a massive glaive held diagonally, a crimson-violet chest core behind cracked plates, a tattered stone-grey cloak. Tell: glaive raised high, halo shards flaring. Attack: glaive slammed down toward +X.
